description: This file contains unit tests for the Abseil time library, specifically testing the behavior of absl::Now() and absl::SleepFor() functions, including handling of alarms and timing bounds.

methods.name: AlarmHandler
methods.description: Signal handler invoked when alarm signal is received, sets a flag indicating the alarm was invoked.

methods.name: SleepForBounded
methods.description: Function that tests whether absl::SleepFor() completes within specified timing bounds, optionally using an alarm.

methods.name: AssertSleepForBounded
methods.description: Assertion helper that verifies SleepForBounded() succeeds within the given bounds and timeout.
